name: duplo-train
description: Showcase: controlling a LEGO DUPLO Train Base from Node.js with node-poweredup (verbose pairing/command logs, sensors, sounds, motor)

scripts.app: concurrently -k -n train,web -c green,cyan "npm run server" "npm run web"
scripts.app:mock: concurrently -k -n train,web -c green,cyan "npm run server:mock" "npm run web"
